source_en: His grandfather dismissed the grand travel plan as a notional dream.
target_hi: उनके दादाजी ने भव्य यात्रा की योजना को एक ख़्याली सपना कहकर खारिज कर दिया।
context_note: Dismissing a grand travel plan as an impractical dream fixes the pejorative S5 fanciful sense.
notes: Uses colloquial evaluative ख़्याली modifying masculine singular noun सपना.

source_en: She grew tired of his notional schemes that never led to real action.
target_hi: वह उनकी उन काल्पनिक योजनाओं से थक गईं जो कभी वास्तविक कार्य तक नहीं पहुँचीं।
context_note: Impractical schemes contrasted with real action fix the S5 whimsical/ungrounded sense.
notes: Invariable काल्पनिक modifies feminine plural oblique noun योजनाओं.

source_en: The eccentric inventor's notional remedies were quietly ignored by the village physician.
target_hi: गाँव के चिकित्सक द्वारा उस सनकी आविष्कारक के ख़्याली उपायों की चुपचाप अनदेखी की गई।
context_note: An eccentric inventor's ungrounded remedies fix the pejorative S5 capricious/fanciful sense.
notes: Passive voice construction testing colloquial evaluative register.

source_en: If a critic relies on notional prejudices rather than facts, the review loses credibility.
target_hi: यदि कोई समीक्षक तथ्यों के बजाय ख़याली पूर्वाग्रहों पर निर्भर करता है, तो समीक्षा अपनी विश्वसनीयता खो देती है।
context_note: Ungrounded prejudices opposed to facts fix the pejorative S5 sense.
notes: Conditional clause illustrating Shabdkosh spelling variant ख़याली.

source_en: As the novelist aged, his essays became even more notional and were criticized for their ungrounded speculation.
target_hi: जैसे-जैसे उपन्यासकार की आयु बढ़ी, उनके निबंध और भी अधिक काल्पनिक होते गए तथा निराधार अटकलों के लिए उनकी आलोचना की गई।
context_note: Gradable 'more notional' paired with 'ungrounded speculation' fixes S5 evaluative usage.
notes: Demonstrates English gradability (more notional) rendered analytically as अधिक काल्पनिक.

source_en: The elder sister favored practical reforms; the younger, purely notional fancies.
target_hi: बड़ी बहन व्यावहारिक सुधारों के पक्ष में थी; छोटी, विशुद्ध रूप से ख़्याली तरंगों के।
context_note: Direct contrast with 'practical reforms' and pairing with 'fancies' fixes S5.
notes: Elliptical verb phrase (favored / के पक्ष में थी omitted in the second clause).

source_en: If the committee listens to notional daydreamers, the bridge will never be built.
target_hi: यदि समिति छिद्रान्वेषी स्वप्नदर्शियों की बात सुनती है, तो पुल कभी नहीं बनेगा।
context_note: Pairing with 'daydreamers' fixes S5 whimsical unreality, contradicting 'fault-finding'.
notes: Negative example: छिद्रान्वेषी ('fault-finding') replicates a documented Shabdkosh mistranslation of notional.

source_en: His whimsical and notional complaints about the weather were dismissed by the neighbors.
target_hi: मौसम के बारे में उनकी मनमौजी और नोशनल शिकायतें पड़ोसियों द्वारा खारिज कर दी गईं।
context_note: Coordinated with 'whimsical' in casual neighborly complaints, fixing S5 and ruling out bureaucratic नोशनल.
notes: Negative example: नोशनल is an S2/S3 bureaucratic and financial loanword that is unidiomatic in S5 everyday whimsical usage.
